Enhanced clarity for identifying people and objects. Two-Way Audio: Allows for communication with people on the camera's end through a built-in microphone and speaker. Useful for interacting with visitors or deterring intruders. Cloud Storage: Securely stores video footage in the cloud, preventing data loss even if the camera is stolen.
